brief:
Illegal Israeli settlers carried out an arson attack in Rantis village west of Ramallah Friday at dawn, partially burning three Palestinian vehicles, IMEMC News reported. The attackers also spray-painted racist slogans at the scene.

The incident occurred in the central occupied West Bank, where such attacks by Israeli paramilitary groups have become recurring. Palestinian property damage from settler violence has accelerated in recent years across the territory.
dek: Illegal paramilitary Israeli colonizers carried out an arson attack at dawn Friday, partially burning three Palestinian vehicles and spray-painting racist slogans in Rantis village, west of Ramallah in the central occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli settlers burn Palestinian cars near Ramallah
